name: genome-canvas
description: A local-network genome browser for server and public tracks

scripts.test: python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_*.py' && node --test tests/test_track_colors.mjs tests/test_signal_style.mjs tests/test_annotation_style.mjs tests/test_hic_heatmap.mjs tests/test_public_hubs.mjs tests/test_highlights.mjs tests/test_manhattan_style.mjs tests/test_reference_resources.mjs tests/test_canvas_theme.mjs
scripts.vendor:update: mkdir -p vendor && cp node_modules/igv/dist/igv.min.js vendor/igv.min.js && cp node_modules/igv/LICENSE vendor/IGV-LICENSE.txt
